bfc8920c9b.q: What is Skyflow's approach to securing sensitive data when AI agents access it for customer interactions?
bfc8920c9b.a: Skyflow ensures that plain text data stays out of the wrong hands, logs, and compute systems. The platform sits between consumers and models to determine what data should and should not go to models in plain text. Additionally, Skyflow enforces policy controls to restrict which agents can access specific data types, such as preventing agents from using credit card numbers when they should only use corporate cards.

c1ec21808c.q: What misconception do security leaders have about AI security versus traditional cybersecurity?
c1ec21808c.a: The first misconception is the word 'security' itself. In the old world with deterministic flows, security companies could isolate problems (like firewalls for network traffic). But with non-deterministic AI models and agents, you cannot isolate security problems down to one thing. Instead, you must invert the problem and build a secure, privacy-preserving, controllable infrastructure in place that secures data at all times.

66cdee4ff0.q: Why is cybersecurity a failed industry according to leaders in AI infrastructure?
66cdee4ff0.a: Cybersecurity is a failed industry because even before AI, it was poorly implemented and wasteful. After AI, the problem worsens because 80% of the time security means controlling data rather than just preventing external bad actors from accessing it. Unlike healthcare or cybersecurity in the old model, the problem requires thinking about data control from a fundamentally different perspective.
